006package dev.metaschema.core.metapath.function.library;
007
008import java.util.List;
009import java.util.function.BiFunction;
010
011import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.DynamicContext;
012import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.MetapathConstants;
013import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.function.FunctionUtils;
014import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.function.IArgument;
015import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.function.IFunction;
016import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.item.IItem;
017import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.item.ISequence;
018import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.item.atomic.IAnyAtomicItem;
019import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.item.function.IMapItem;
020import dev.metaschema.core.util.ObjectUtils;
021import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.NonNull;
022
023/**
024 * Implements the XPath 3.1 <a href=
025 * "https://www.w3.org/TR/xpath-functions-31/#func-map-for-each">map:for-each</a>
026 * function.
027 */
028public final class MapForEach {
029  private static final String NAME = "for-each";
030  @NonNull
031  static final IFunction SIGNATURE = IFunction.builder()
032      .name(NAME)
033      .namespace(MetapathConstants.NS_METAPATH_FUNCTIONS_MAP)
034      .deterministic()
035      .contextIndependent()
036      .focusIndependent()
037      .argument(IArgument.builder()
038          .name("map")
039          .type(IMapItem.type())
040          .one()
041          .build())
042      .argument(IArgument.builder()
043          .name("action")
044          .type(IFunction.type())
045          .one()
046          .build())
047      .returnType(IItem.type())
048      .returnZeroOrMore()
049      .functionHandler(MapForEach::execute)
050      .build();
051
052  private MapForEach() {
053    // disable construction
054  }
055
056  @SuppressWarnings("unused")
057  @NonNull
058  private static ISequence<?> execute(@NonNull IFunction function,
059      @NonNull List<ISequence<?>> arguments,
060      @NonNull DynamicContext dynamicContext,
061      IItem focus) {
062    IMapItem<?> map = FunctionUtils.asType(ObjectUtils.requireNonNull(arguments.get(0).getFirstItem(true)));
063    IFunction action = FunctionUtils.asType(ObjectUtils.requireNonNull(arguments.get(1).getFirstItem(true)));
064
065    BiFunction<IAnyAtomicItem, ISequence<?>, ISequence<?>> lambda = adaptFunction(action, dynamicContext);
066    return forEach(map, lambda);
067  }
068
069  /**
070   * Adapts the provided function call to a lambda expression for use with
071   * {@link #forEach(IMapItem, BiFunction)}.
072   *
073   * @param function
074   *          the function to adapt
075   * @param dynamicContext
076   *          the dynamic context for use in evaluating the function
077   * @return a lambda expression
078   */
079  @NonNull
080  private static BiFunction<IAnyAtomicItem, ISequence<?>, ISequence<?>> adaptFunction(
081      @NonNull IFunction function,
082      @NonNull DynamicContext dynamicContext) {
083    return (key, value) -> {
084      List<ISequence<?>> arguments = ObjectUtils.notNull(List.of(
085          ISequence.of(key),
086          value.toSequence()));
087
088      return function.execute(arguments, dynamicContext, ISequence.empty());
089    };
090  }
091
092  /**
093   * An implementation of XPath 3.1 <a href=
094   * "https://www.w3.org/TR/xpath-functions-31/#func-map-for-each">map:for-each</a>.
095   *
096   * @param map
097   *          the map of Metapath items that is the target of retrieval
098   * @param action
099   *          the action to perform on each entry in the map
100   * @return a stream resulting from concatenating the resulting streams provided
101   *         by the action result
102   */
103  @NonNull
104  public static ISequence<?> forEach(
105      @NonNull IMapItem<?> map,
106      @NonNull BiFunction<IAnyAtomicItem, ISequence<?>, ISequence<?>> action) {
107    return ISequence.of(ObjectUtils.notNull(map.entrySet().stream()
108        .flatMap(entry -> {
109          IAnyAtomicItem key = entry.getKey().getKey();
110          ISequence<?> values = entry.getValue().contentsAsSequence();
111          return action.apply(key, values).stream();
112        })));
113  }
114}
